name: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive
paste:
DAVCO GREY ONE POT ADHESIVE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive, November 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/davco-grey-one-potadhesive.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Davco Grey One Pot adhesive where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. A pre-mixed, ready to use, flexible tile adhesive.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for common board substrates such as fibre cement sheet, plasterboard, and ceramic tile underlay.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive can also be used with rendered brickwork and blockwork.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is designed for use for domestic residential applications on wall and porous floor substrates including kitchens, bathrooms and laundries.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for use on internal applications only.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is not suitable for tiling over concrete, waterproofing membranes or existing ceramic tiles, use a suitable Sika cement-based adhesives for these substrates.
    - Ceramic tiles
    - Porcelain tiles
    - Mosaic tiles
    Suitable tile types include;
    Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.7.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Davco Grey One Pot adhesive
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A PRE-MIXED, READY TO USE FLEXIBLE TILE ADHESIVE
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (November 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Product Declaration (p.1).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Pre-mixed and ready to use
    - Suitable for internal walls and floors
    - Used for thin bed tiling
    - Ideal for porous tiles
    - Grey in appearance
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product Declaration: D1E as per AS ISO 13007 Classification
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 36g/Ltr (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Available in 1Ltr, 4Ltr or 10Ltr Pail
    - Shelf life: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture.
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions out of direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Surface preparation.
    - All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling.
    - Deeply contaminated surfaces must be scabbled / abraded to a clean, sound surface. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces.
    - Surfaces should be prepared and primed as per table below:
    | SUBSTRATE rendered brick or blockwork | SPECIFIC REQUIREMENT Cured minimum 7 days Sound | PRIMER Davco Ultraprime or Dav- |
    | (rough float finish) | (not drummy or cracked) | co PrimeX |
    | Fibre cement sheet, plasterboard | Correctly and firmly fixed | Davco Ultraprime or Davco PrimeX |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (November 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Consumption: 10 Litres of Davco Grey One Pot adhesive cover approximately 7.5m2 (based on a 6mm notched trowel)
    - Open Time: 30 minutes at 22°C & 50% relative humidity.
    - Setting Time: 24 hours (before grouting) at 22°C & 50% relative humidity.
    - Adjustability Time: 15-25 minutes dependant on tile and substrate porosity.
4.3 Applied Product Ready for Use.
    - Allow product to set firmly before return to service.
    - Allow 24 hours drying before returning to dry area service.
    - Allow a minimum 7 days drying before returning to wet area service
    Drying times are to be used as a guide only. Product tested at 22°C & 50% relative humidity.
4.4 Equipment. Select a trowel with an appropriate square-notch size for the size and type of tile, as per the following:
    | Tile size | Trowel notch size | Back buttering required |
    | Mosaic tiles | 4-6mm | - |
    | 150x150mm | 6mm | - |
    | 200x200mm | 8mm | - |
    | 250x250mm | 10mm | - |
    | 300x300mm | 10mm | - |
    | 400x400mm and larger | 12mm | Yes |
    | Any tile with uneven back, lugs or grooves | As above, dependant on size | Yes |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
4.5 Application. Laying the tiles. 1. Deposit a quantity of adhesive onto the prepared substrate. – Do not apply more adhesive than can be tiled within the open time of the product, usually from a single tile up to around 1m2 at a time. 2. Hold the notched trowel at an angle of 60º or greater to the substrate. 3. Spread the adhesive over the area where tile is to be applied, forming straight rows of adhesive “beads”. 4. Where “back buttering” is required, use the straight side of the trowel to apply a thin covering of adhesive to the back of the tile. 5. Position the tile on the beaded adhesive and press firmly. 6. Move the tile forward and then back at 90º across the direction of the beads to ensure all beads are flattened 7. Leaving no voids under the tile. Occasionally lift a tile after placing it to check that the beads are fully compressed and that sufficient coverage has been achieved (90–100%). Replace the tile. 8. After laying a section at a time, remove any excess adhesive from the grout joint and the surface of the tiles with a damp cloth while the adhesive is still wet. Note: Setting time of adhesive is affected by site conditions, climate and could be faster or slower than specified.
4.6 Cleaning of tools. Clean tools and equipment with water before the adhesive dries.
4.7 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Test the adhesive in an inconspicuous area first
    - It is essential to plan the area to be tiled, with inclusion of movement joints in accordance with all relevant standard(s).
    - All surfaces must be suitably sound, clean and installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and relevant Australian Standard(s)
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
    - In cool and / or humid conditions, allow longer setting times.
    - Do not allow the adhesive to skin prior to laying the tiles. If the adhesive skins remove and dispose of it, then re-apply fresh adhesive.
    - Movement joints must be installed in accordance with the relevant standard(s). Failure to do so may result in drummy or lifting tiles.
    - Not suitable for tiling over concrete, waterproofing membranes or existing ceramic tiles – use a suitable Davco cement-based adhesive
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone – use Davco 2 Part Rapid
    - When using Davco Grey One Pot adhesive with translucent / absorbent tiles, the colour of the adhesive must be considered.
    - Davco Grey One Pot adhesive is suitable for adhering porous (>3% absorption) tiles over Davco Waterproofing Membranes for walls only. However, the drying time before grouting will be greatly extended.
    - For applications not mentioned in this document please contact Sika Australia.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.7):
    - Do not apply in temperatures above 35ºC or below 5ºC
    - Not suitable for moisture sensitive stone – use Davco 2 Part Rapid
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Test the adhesive in an inconspicuous area first
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Davco Grey One Pot adhesive, November 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/4/davco-grey-one-potadhesive.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Davco Grey One Pot Adhesive, version 09/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/y/MSDS%20Davco%20Grey%20One%20Pot%20adhesive%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Davco Grey One Pot adhesive, version 18/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sds-davco-grey-onepotadhesive.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Various Semi-Finished, version 18/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/7/sds-various-semi-finished.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
